sentences.text:
Main Case No.: W.P.No.296 of 2025
 Proceeding Sheet
Sl. Date Order

OFFICE No. NOTE 03. 09.01.2025 TRR,J  Learned counsel appearing for the  petitioners would submit that there is a cart way in  the subject land and the respondents are trying to lay the CC road in the said cart way and the said cart way is belong to the petitioners herein and the respondents have no right to lay the CC road in the subject land.

The petitioners are admitting that a cart way is in existence in the subject land and if at all the respondents intends to lay a CC road, the petitioners are entitled to claim compensation under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, subject to proof and title over the property.
